title: COVID-19 SEIR Wave Simulator
description: Interactive SEIR compartmental model for COVID-19 with controls for transmission rate, vaccination coverage, variant R0, and waning immunity. Overlays Delta vs Omicron at matched vaccination coverage.
creator: Introduction to Public Health Project
subject: public health
epidemiology
infectious disease modeling
COVID-19
SEIR model
compartmental model
learning_objective: Analyze how transmission rate, vaccination coverage, variant R0, and waning immunity interact to shape COVID-19 wave dynamics, and explain why early single-scenario projections systematically diverged from observed multi-wave outcomes.
